successors.name: Congo Free State
successors.text: Msiri's state as the Bunkeya page bounds it, 'from the Luapula River south to the Congo-Zambezi watershed' and 'from Lake Mweru in the east to the Lualaba River in the west': the part of Katanga east…

ledger.x: 1867: Msiri takes the west bank of the Luapula.
1891 December: Msiri is killed and the Yeke kingdom ends.

wars.name: Msiri against Kazembe
wars.outcome: Msiri took the west bank of the Luapula by 1867; with Tippu Tip 'he formed an alliance with Msiri to attack and kill Mwata Kazembe in 1870'.

wars.name: Stairs Expedition to Katanga
wars.outcome: The Free State's Stairs Expedition reached Bunkeya on 14 December 1891 (Msiri page) and Msiri was killed on 20 December (Yeke infobox); the kingdom ended and was taken over for the Congo Free State.

certainty.note: A trading kingdom with no frontier given; the Bunkeya page names the Luapula and Lake Mweru (east), the Lualaba (west) and the Congo-Zambezi watershed (south), the area figure of half a million km2 has no year.
